notes: Selectors registry. Populated from recon artifact 2026-05-22. Most associate-data selectors are intentionally not listed because the API (endpoints.json::main_init) returns the data directly and is preferred over DOM scraping.

search.storeNumberInput.notes: Stable ID. Value can be set with .value = and a dispatched 'input' event.

search.dateInput.notes: Native HTML5 date input. valueLength=10 confirms ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

results.associateScheduleToggle.purpose: Show/hide button for the Associate Schedule region.
results.associateScheduleToggle.notes: May need to be clicked once if the section is hidden; check display state first.

section.repeatingBlock.purpose: Per-task-area container holding section header, counts, and 'Assign Tasks...' link.
section.repeatingBlock.notes: 15 task areas observed in the test run; layout is a 4x4 grid (Fitting Room TA at 32; not all 16 cells populated).

section.assignTasksLink.purpose: Opens the Assign Tasks panel for a section.
section.assignTasksLink.source: recon click events at 21310ms and 26538ms (divAssocSched10, divAssocSched21)
section.assignTasksLink.notes: NOT REQUIRED for extraction. The associate data is available from the Main.ashx API. This selector is recorded for completeness only.

section.writeInCountInput.purpose: User-editable write-in count for a task area.
section.writeInCountInput.notes: TAName values: Stocking2TA, OvernightTA, OvernightMaintenance, Stocking1TA, FashionTA, FashionStockingTA, Meat-ProduceTA, Deli-BakeryTA, FoodTA, SeasonalTA, EntertainmentTA, Health&BeautyTA, HardlinesTA, HomelinesTA, FittingRoomTA. Note unescaped & in 'Health&BeautyTA' — use attribute selector form '[id="Health&BeautyTA_write_in_assoc"]'.

section.callOffCountInput.purpose: User-editable call-off count for a task area.
section.callOffCountInput.notes: These are NUMERIC AGGREGATE inputs the user fills in on the page, not per-associate flags. Per-associate call-off detection should rely on schedule_changes / scheduled_associates row fields from the API instead.
